client.gitConflict.title: Resolve merge conflicts
client.gitConflict.hint: Use the arrows to accept code, or edit the middle pane and mark the block resolved. Keep both puts the left side first.
client.gitConflict.deleteConfirm: Delete this file and mark the conflict resolved?
client.gitConflict.reloadConfirm: Reloading will discard your unsaved merge result. Continue?
client.gitConflict.closeConfirm: Your merge result has not been saved. Close anyway?
client.gitConflict.banner: {count} files have conflicts. Merge them here one at a time.
client.gitConflict.ready: All conflicts are resolved. Continue to commit the merge result.
client.gitConflict.unsupported: This file is not editable text or exceeds 512 KB. Use a local tool to resolve it.
client.gitConflict.changed: The file or merge state has changed. Copy any edits you want to keep, then reload.
client.gitConflict.markersRemain: Unresolved conflicts or conflict markers remain. Resolve them before saving or continuing.
client.gitConflict.continueFailed: The operation is still unfinished. Check for new conflicts or review your Git identity, commit checks, and signing settings.
client.gitConflict.resolveFirst: Resolve the conflicts and continue the pending integration first.
client.gitConflict.integrationStopped: The update paused. Resolve conflicts in the Git panel and continue.
